integrity: Mathematical argument uses definable bipartition/missing matching, sharp scoped counting formulas and an infinite-duration pebble strategy. Two separately executable finite checkers and their complete outputs are included. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs G(a,b,t) with a,b>=3 only; no side predicates, counting, arbitrary edge deletion or lower-side-size cases. Finite program tests are not proof of the unrestricted theorem. Priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Exact finite-variable spectrum of matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs
